title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to create containers on one label could use the…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with permission to create containers on one label can create a container referencing a parent container they cannot access. This allows alteration of incident lineage across authorization boundaries and identification of restricted containers. The issue arises because the REST API accepts a user-supplied parent container without verifying access permissions to that container.
